title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
source: Project Gutenberg #345 · public domain · full text also at library/bram-stoker.json in Amenti.live
note:
THE BOOK IS ALREADY CAST. Dracula is epistolary and Stoker names the document type at the head of every chapter — a journal, a letter, a ship's log, a phonograph diary, a newspaper cutting. The entrances and exits are on the page; a staged reading does not have to invent them. That is why this is the first work.

CHAPTERS ARE NOT EPISODES. A chapter may hold several documents and several speakers, and a document may run across chapters. The list below is the chapter map; episodes are cut from it.
